task.description:
Validate that API-01 is ready for release.

Checks:
1. Read tests/reports/WF02-api01-20260522-test-report.json — overall must be PASS
2. Verify zig build exits 0
3. Verify all API-01 acceptance criteria are satisfied by the implementation:
   - RFC 9457 Problem Details struct has: type (URI), title, status, detail
   - HTTP success codes: 200, 201, 204 are implemented in response.zig
   - Content-Type: application/json enforcement is implemented (415 on mismatch)
   - PUT with no body → HTTP 400
   - POST to non-existent resource path → HTTP 404 (note: this is handled by router/not-found handler, not a new requirement on errors.zig — confirm the design covers it)
4. Confirm no NFR regressions: zig build test must still exit 0

Produce result:
  PASS if all checks pass → next_action: 'Route to DOC-UPDATER'
  FAIL if any check fails → list blocking issues with severity
acceptance_criteria: All API-01 ACs confirmed satisfied by code inspection

result.summary: Release APPROVED for Stage 4 (API-01). All 22 unit tests pass, zig build exits 0, all API-01 acceptance criteria verified by code inspection.
result.next_action: Route to DOC-UPDATER to set API-01 status RELEASED
